prova:
refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
  intro N _ A hA hAdm
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    rcases h with ⟨rfl, ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩⟩
    norm_num at ha
  have hAsub : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := by
    simpa [Set.Icc] using hA
  have hAunit : A.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) := Finset.pairwise_ne_iff.mpr (by
    intro x hx y hy hxy
    exact (hAsub.le hxy).elim (by simp) (by simp))
  have hAne : A.Nonempty → A.Nonempty := by tauto
  have hcard : (A.card : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by
    have hcardnat : A.card ≤ N := by
      by_contra h
      have : (A.card : ℕ) > N := by omega
      -- if more than N elements in {1,…,N} then two coincide, contradicting A.Pairwise
      have hcardpos : 0 < A.card := by
        simp [Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le] at h
        omega
      have hsize : (A : Set ℕ).Finite := Finset.finite_toSet A
      -- pigeonhole: image of A under id into {1,…,N} injective? no, it IS injective
      -- but A has card > N and is a subset of {1,…,N} which has card N, impossible.
      have hIccCard : (Finset.Icc (1 : ℕ) N).card = N := by
        have hNpos' : 1 ≤ N := by omega
        rw [Finset.card_Icc, hNpos', Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      have hAsub' : A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 N := hAsub
      have hcardle : A.card ≤ (Finset.Icc 1 N).card := Finset.card_le_of_subset hAsub'
      omega
    exact mod_cast hcardnat
  have hbound : (N : ℝ) ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 4) - 1 := by
    have hpos : 0 < (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hNpos
    have hpos2 : 0 < (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 := by linarith
    have hsq : ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 2) ^ 2 = ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 4) + (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 := by
      ring
    have hsq2 : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 := by linarith
    have hsqrtle : (N : ℝ) + 1 / 2 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 4) := by
      have : 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 := hsq2
      have : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.sqrt ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 4) := by positivity
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (show 0 ≤ (N : ℝ) + 1 / 4 from hsq2),
        Real.sqrt_nonneg ((N : ℝ) + 1 / 4)]
    linarith
  linarith
